title: Not-found.js not working on production server when using runtime edge

labels.name: bug
labels.description: Issue was opened via the bug report template.

labels.name: linear: next
labels.description: Confirmed issue that is tracked by the Next.js team.

body:
### Verify canary release

- [X] I verified that the issue exists in the latest Next.js canary release

### Provide environment information

```bash
Operating System:
  Platform: linux
  Arch: x64
  Version: #7-Ubuntu SMP PREEMPT_DYNAMIC Fri Jun 23 15:37:39 UTC 2023
Binaries:
  Node: 20.3.0
  npm: 9.6.7
  Yarn: N/A
  pnpm: 8.6.6
Relevant Packages:
  next: 13.4.13-canary.18
  eslint-config-next: N/A
  react: 18.2.0
  react-dom: 18.2.0
  typescript: 5.1.6
Next.js Config:
  output: N/A
```


### Which area(s) of Next.js are affected? (leave empty if unsure)

_No response_

### Link to the code that reproduces this issue or a replay of the bug

https://github.com/azvyae/next-minimal-production-repo

### To Reproduce

`npm run build` (production files)

`npm start` run the server

When accessing /foobar it will takes forever to load.

You can try to access the deployment url here 

https://next-minimal-repro-not-found-js.vercel.app/foobar


### Describe the Bug

I can confirm this that it happened also on latest canary release. The not-found.js file is not working when i'm using runtime edge in production.

### Expected Behavior

It should show custom not found page, and it should work when uploading custom not-found.js at cloudflare pages (who uses edge runtime)

### Which browser are you using? (if relevant)

Microsoft Edge Version 115.0.1901.188 (Official build) (64-bit)

### How are you deploying your application? (if relevant)
